sketch_notes: The sketches imply a content-heavy repository/detail page with relatively modest but important JavaScript needs: responsive navigation on mobile, likely contextual dropdown behavior, and collapsible sidebar sections on desktop. Mobile complexity centers on compact navigation and utility access within a constrained header, while desktop complexity shifts toward managing right-rail disclosure panels alongside a large primary content area. No clear evidence of tabs, modals, toast messages, or explicit infinite scroll appears, but keyboard/focus handling is essential because the inferred menus and accordion-style disclosures must work accessibly across both viewports.
